question: Why is the supreme lord called the revealer of the spectacle of creation and destruction?
premises: The supreme lord is unbarred in own self-space.
He reveals the spectacle of creation and destruction.
The spectacle is of this much.
inference: The unbarred supreme lord reveals the whole spectacle of creation and destruction.
uncertainties: iyataḥ may qualify the spectacle or the lord.
plain_english: Therefore that supreme lord, unbarred in his own self-space, reveals the spectacle of creation and destruction.
